The competition rules state that: To be eligible to enter the Competition, you must be: the older of 18 years old or the age of majority in your jurisdiction of residence (unless otherwise agreed to by the Host and appropriate parental/guardian consents have been obtained by the Host);

I don't completely understand this rule, how can a person under 18 get permission to participate?

Thanks.
